item.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption examines relationships between lobbyists and public officials to identify corruption risks and possible regulatory changes.
item.support: The scope and purpose of this investigation is to consider the relationship between lobbyists and public authorities and public officials

item.text: It compares regulatory arrangements in NSW and other jurisdictions and raises 26 principal issues about lobbying and its oversight.
item.support: The issues paper is structured around 26 principal issues.

item.text: The Commission raises potential weaknesses involving exclusions from regulation, limited disclosure, record-keeping and the independence of oversight.
item.support: there are other matters that may be considered as potential weaknesses in the current regulatory system applicable to lobbyists.
item.section: 10. What are the weaknesses of the current NSW regulatory system?

item.text: It invites submissions to inform the investigation and proposes a public inquiry and report.
item.support: The Commission also proposes to conduct a public inquiry for the purpose of the investigation
